blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Way back, when the judges ruled, a famine hit the land. A man from Bethlehem named Elimelech took his wife Naomi and their two sons over to Moab to find bread.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Then Elimelech died. The boys married women from Moab, Orpah and Ruth. And about ten years later, both of those sons died too. Three widows, Church. Nothing in their hands.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Naomi heard that the LORD had visited his people back home and given them bread. So she started for home, and her daughters-in-law walked with her.

verses.text: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law,

segments.speaker: naomi
segments.text: Go, return each to her mother’s house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: They cried, and they said they would go with her. Naomi told them to go on back. She had no more sons to give them. She felt like the hand of the LORD had gone out against her.

verses.text: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Orpah kissed her and went home, and nobody in this story fusses at her for it. She went back to her own people. But Ruth held on to that old woman and would not let go.

verses.text: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

segments.speaker: ruth
segments.text: Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

verses.text: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.

segments.speaker: ruth
segments.text: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Those are some of the most loved words in the whole Bible, and they came out of the mouth of a widow from Moab. Not a prophet. Not a priest. A young woman from across the border who would not let an old woman walk that road by herself. We read them at weddings now. She said them on a dusty road to her mother-in-law.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: When they came to Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred. The women asked, is this Naomi?

verses.text: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

segments.speaker: naomi
segments.text: Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

verses.text: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?

segments.speaker: naomi
segments.text: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: She told the truth about her grief. She did not dress it up for church, and the Bible lets her say it. But read the last line slow.

verses.text: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The beginning of barley harvest. Naomi came home empty, with Ruth by her side, right when the fields were turning gold. She could not see it yet. Grief cannot always see the harvest coming. But her story was already turning.
